title: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted missiles and drones from Iran-backed Houthis
summary: Saudi Arabia has announced the successful interception of missiles and drones launched by the Iran-backed Houthi movement. This development comes as the Houthis have reportedly targeted airports and energy facilities, escalating concerns over regional supply stability. The situation highlights the ongoing tensions in the Middle East and the implications for international security and energy markets.
